evidence_boundary: Local source and test evidence only. No hosted access, deployment, proposal or capital mutation was attempted. PERSONA_EVALUATOR_PAPER_POOL_ID is unset by default, so the cycle stays inactive until an operator configures a paper pool.

design.trigger: persona-evaluator-agent paper_cycle_once, after run_once on every interval; acts only when a quarter before the current one has a persisted ranking snapshot (state.latest) and no applied cycle is recorded
design.owner_cycle: services/capital/paper_allocation_cycle.py: recompute from the admitted snapshot, policy persona-paper-quarterly-allocation-v1, create one rebalance proposal per tenant+quarter+pool, apply automatically inside the paper ledger (approval_ref paper-auto:<id>), receipt + audit_ref + rollback_target
design.idempotency: rebalance_id derived from tenant|quarter|pool; an existing cycle is returned, an unapplied one is only completed; evaluator also records applied cycles in its state
design.policy: calculate_paper_competition_allocations reuses calculate_target_allocations (score share, tier caps S25/A15/B8, +25% increase cap, exclusions) with paper_running as the positive stage; sum of weights above 1.0 refuses the cycle
design.pool_health: evaluator derives risk_budget_factor = min(1, gross_utilisation/budget_full) and capacity_factor = 1 - idle_day_share from the persona's current strategy-pool decision.health; anything unknown stays 1.0 with the reason stored in pool_health_factors (O-21)
design.real_capital_unchanged: calculate_target_allocations defaults, real evaluate endpoint, human approval and apply path are untouched; factor fields are context fields only for the paper quarterly policy; the cycle refuses non-paper pools, non-dev environments and non-paper lines

decisions_for_review: capacity_factor = 1 - idle_day_share is an implementation choice for 'could the persona use more capital'; the addendum names budget-full plus waiting candidates, for which no persisted source exists yet
Only the latest closed quarter with a persisted snapshot is cycled; older missed quarters are not replayed
The evaluator's BFF token must carry the operator role (and tenant scope) to call the write route; no token change was made here
Personas without paper_ledger_id on the ranking item or without exactly one active paper_owner binding are skipped with a recorded reason (simulation.skipped); no eligible persona refuses the cycle
With three tier-3 personas the 8% tier cap leaves most of the paper pool unallocated; this is the existing policy, not changed here
